Hi all. @Yaël Dillies was reviewing PR #37810 and they noted that the coercions which are currently written out by hand should be generated with @[simps]. I've made several attempts to try to figure out how to get @[simps] to generate these, but haven't been able to.

Would an expert be able to help me figure out how to generate those simp lemmas?

Thanks!
If not, I'll have a look in two weeks when I'm back from holidays
